<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>State of Developer Ecosystem 2024: Language Trends, Satisfaction, and Strategic Shifts</title>

    <!-- Google Fonts: Archivo Black (display) + DM Mono (data) + DM Sans (body) -->
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Archivo+Black&family=DM+Mono:wght@400;500&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

    <style>
        /* ===========================================
           CSS CUSTOM PROPERTIES — THEME
           Dark data-forward theme for engineering leaders
           Primary: deep slate | Accent: electric amber
           =========================================== */
        :root {
            --bg-primary: #0e1117;
            --bg-secondary: #161b27;
            --bg-card: #1c2235;
            --bg-card-hover: #212840;
            --text-primary: #f0f2f7;
            --text-secondary: #8892a4;
            --text-muted: #5a6478;
            --accent: #f5a623;
            --accent-dim: rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.15);
            --accent-glow: rgba(245, 166, 35, 0.4);
            --accent-green: #39d98a;
            --accent-red: #ff5c5c;
            --accent-blue: #4d94ff;
            --accent-purple: #a78bfa;
            --grid-line: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
            --border: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);

            /* Typography */
            --font-display: 'Archivo Black', sans-serif;
            --font-body: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
            --font-mono: 'DM Mono', monospace;

            /* Spacing — clamp() for all sizes */
            --slide-padding: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 4.5rem);
            --content-gap: clamp(0.75rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            --element-gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem);

            /* Typography sizing */
            --title-size: clamp(1.5rem, 4.5vw, 3.8rem);
            --h2-size: clamp(1.1rem, 2.8vw, 2.2rem);
            --h3-size: clamp(0.9rem, 1.8vw, 1.4rem);
            --body-size: clamp(0.72rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            --small-size: clamp(0.62rem, 0.9vw, 0.8rem);
            --label-size: clamp(0.6rem, 0.85vw, 0.75rem);
            --mono-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);

            --ease-out-expo: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
            --ease-out-quint: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           BASE RESET
           =========================================== */
        *, *::before, *::after { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

        body {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--body-size);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           VIEWPORT BASE — MANDATORY (from viewport-base.css)
           =========================================== */
        html, body { height: 100%; overflow-x: hidden; }

        html {
            scroll-snap-type: y mandatory;
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        .slide {
            width: 100vw;
            height: 100vh;
            height: 100dvh;
            overflow: hidden;
            scroll-snap-align: start;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            position: relative;
        }

        .slide-content {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            max-height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
        }

        .card, .container, .content-box {
            max-width: min(90vw, 1000px);
            max-height: min(80vh, 700px);
        }

        .feature-list, .bullet-list { gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 1rem); }
        .feature-list li, .bullet-list li { font-size: var(--body-size); line-height: 1.4; }

        img, .image-container {
            max-width: 100%;
            max-height: min(50vh, 400px);
            object-fit: contain;
        }

        @media (max-height: 700px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.75rem, 3vw, 2rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 4.5vw, 2.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.75rem);
            }
        }

        @media (max-height: 600px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.5rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.3rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.1rem, 4vw, 2rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 0.95rem);
            }
            .nav-dots, .keyboard-hint, .decorative { display: none; }
        }

        @media (max-height: 500px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.4rem, 2vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1rem, 3.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(0.9rem, 2.5vw, 1.25rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            :root { --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 7vw, 2.5rem); }
        }

        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            *, *::before, *::after {
                animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                transition-duration: 0.2s !important;
            }
            html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           GLOBAL BACKGROUND GRID PATTERN
           =========================================== */
        .slide::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(var(--grid-line) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, var(--grid-line) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 60px 60px;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
        }

        .slide > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }

        /* ===========================================
           ANIMATIONS — Entrance Reveals
           =========================================== */
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(28px);
            transition: opacity 0.65s var(--ease-out-expo), transform 0.65s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .reveal-left {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(calc(-1 * clamp(20px, 3vw, 40px)));
            transition: opacity 0.6s var(--ease-out-expo), transform 0.6s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: scale(0.92);
            transition: opacity 0.5s var(--ease-out-quint), transform 0.5s var(--ease-out-quint);
        }

        .slide.visible .reveal,
        .slide.visible .reveal-left,
        .slide.visible .reveal-scale { opacity: 1; transform: none; }

        /* Staggered delays */
        .reveal:nth-child(1), .reveal-left:nth-child(1), .reveal-scale:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.05s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(2), .reveal-left:nth-child(2), .reveal-scale:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.15s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(3), .reveal-left:nth-child(3), .reveal-scale:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.25s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(4), .reveal-left:nth-child(4), .reveal-scale:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.35s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.42s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 0.49s; }

        /* For table rows and chart bars staggered by JS */
        .row-reveal { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(calc(-1 * clamp(12px, 2vw, 20px))); transition: opacity 0.5s var(--ease-out-expo), transform 0.5s var(--ease-out-expo); }
        .slide.visible .row-reveal { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
        .bar-reveal { opacity: 0; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: opacity 0.6s, transform 0.6s var(--ease-out-expo); }
        .slide.visible .bar-reveal { opacity: 1; transform: scaleX(1); }

        /* ===========================================
           PROGRESS BAR
           =========================================== */
        .progress-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0; left: 0;
            height: 2px;
            background: var(--accent);
            z-index: 9999;
            transition: width 0.3s var(--ease-out-quint);
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-glow);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           NAV DOTS
           =========================================== */
        .nav-dots {
            position: fixed;
            right: clamp(0.75rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            z-index: 9998;
        }

        .nav-dot {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--text-muted);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: background 0.25s, transform 0.25s;
        }

        .nav-dot.active {
            background: var(--accent);
            transform: scale(1.4);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SHARED SLIDE COMPONENTS
           =========================================== */

        /* Slide number badge */
        .slide-badge {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 0.12em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 1rem);
        }

        .slide-badge span {
            color: var(--accent);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        /* Section heading */
        .slide-heading {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.15;
            letter-spacing: -0.01em;
        }

        .slide-heading em {
            font-style: normal;
            color: var(--accent);
        }

        /* Accent line under heading */
        .heading-rule {
            width: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
            height: 2px;
            background: var(--accent);
            margin: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem) 0;
            border-radius: 1px;
        }

        /* Callout pill */
        .callout-pill {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.4em;
            padding: 0.25em 0.75em;
            border-radius: 999px;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 500;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        }

        .callout-pill.amber { background: var(--accent-dim); color: var(--accent); border: 1px solid rgba(245,166,35,0.3); }
        .callout-pill.green { background: rgba(57,217,138,0.12); color: var(--accent-green); border: 1px solid rgba(57,217,138,0.25); }
        .callout-pill.red { background: rgba(255,92,92,0.12); color: var(--accent-red); border: 1px solid rgba(255,92,92,0.25); }
        .callout-pill.blue { background: rgba(77,148,255,0.12); color: var(--accent-blue); border: 1px solid rgba(77,148,255,0.25); }

        /* Source label */
        .source-label {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1.2rem);
            left: var(--slide-padding);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 1 — TITLE SLIDE
           =========================================== */
        .title-slide {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .title-slide::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: -20%;
            right: -10%;
            width: min(60vw, 700px);
            height: min(60vw, 700px);
            background: radial-gradient(ellipse, rgba(245,166,35,0.06) 0%, transparent 70%);
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
        }

        .title-slide .inner {
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            max-width: min(90vw, 1100px);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1.2rem);
        }

        .title-eyebrow {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent);
            letter-spacing: 0.18em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .title-main {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 5.5vw, 4.8rem);
            line-height: 1.05;
            letter-spacing: -0.025em;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            max-width: min(85vw, 900px);
        }

        .title-main .accent-word { color: var(--accent); }

        .title-sub {
            font-size: clamp(0.8rem, 1.4vw, 1.1rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
            max-width: min(70vw, 650px);
        }

        .title-meta {

<script>
/* ===========================================
   TREND TABLE DATA — injected for staggered animation
   Values from source_brief.md (no fabricated data)
   =========================================== */
const trendData = [
    { lang: 'JavaScript', color: '#f7df1e', vals: ['65%','70%','65%','61%'], delta: '-4 pp', dir: 'down', note: 'Peak 2020, declining' },
    { lang: 'Python',     color: '#3572a5', vals: ['32%','55%','53%','57%'], delta: '+25 pp', dir: 'up',   note: 'Steady growth' },
    { lang: 'HTML/CSS',   color: '#e34c26', vals: ['60%','61%','54%','51%'], delta: '-9 pp',  dir: 'down', note: 'Gradual decline' },
    { lang: 'SQL',        color: '#e38c00', vals: ['42%','56%','49%','48%'], delta: '+6 pp',  dir: 'flat', note: 'Plateaued' },
    { lang: 'Java',       color: '#b07219', vals: ['47%','54%','48%','46%'], delta: '-1 pp',  dir: 'down', note: 'Slow decline' },
    { lang: 'TypeScript', color: '#2b7489', vals: ['12%','28%','34%','37%'], delta: '+25 pp', dir: 'up',   note: 'Strong growth (3×)' },
    { lang: 'Go',         color: '#00add8', vals: ['8%', '19%','19%','18%'], delta: '+10 pp', dir: 'flat', note: 'Plateaued after growth' },
    { lang: 'Rust',       color: '#dea584', vals: ['—',  '7%', '9%', '11%'], delta: 'n/a→11%', dir: 'up',  note: 'Steady growth' },
    { lang: 'PHP',        color: '#4f5d95', vals: ['30%','27%','20%','17%'], delta: '-13 pp', dir: 'down', note: 'Significant decline' },
    { lang: 'Kotlin',     color: '#a97bff', vals: ['2%', '17%','16%','14%'], delta: '+12 pp', dir: 'flat', note: 'Plateaued' },
];

function buildTrendTable() {
    const tbody = document.getElementById('trendTableBody');
    trendData.forEach((row, i) => {
        const tr = document.createElement('tr');
        tr.className = 'row-reveal';
        tr.style.transitionDelay = (0.05 + i * 0.04) + 's';

        // Sparkline bars: normalize vs max value seen (70 for JS)
        const rawNums = row.vals.map(v => parseFloat(v.replace('%','').replace('—','0')));
        const sparkBars = rawNums.map(n => {
            const h = Math.round(Math.max(2, n / 70 * 20));
            const alpha = n > 0 ? 0.3 + (n/70)*0.6 : 0.1;
            return `<div class="spark-bar" style="height:${h}px;background:${row.color};opacity:${alpha.toFixed(2)}"></div>`;
        }).join('');

        const dirIcon = row.dir === 'up' ? '<span class="trend-arrow-up">▲</span>'
                      : row.dir === 'down' ? '<span class="trend-arrow-down">▼</span>'
                      : '<span class="trend-arrow-flat">●</span>';

        // Determine peak value to highlight
        const maxVal = Math.max(...rawNums);

        const cells = row.vals.map((v, vi) => {
            const num = parseFloat(v.replace('%','').replace('—','0'));
            let cls = '';
            if (v === '—') cls = 'val-dash';
            else if (num === maxVal && maxVal > 0) cls = 'val-peak';
            else if (num >= 45) cls = 'val-high';
            else if (num < 20 && num > 0) cls = 'val-low';
            return `<td class="${cls}">${v}</td>`;
        }).join('');

        tr.innerHTML = `
            <td>
                <div class="lang-name-cell">
                    <span class="lang-badge" style="background:${row.color}"></span>
                    ${row.lang}
                </div>
            </td>
            ${cells}
            <td style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:var(--label-size);color:${row.dir==='up'?'var(--accent-green)':row.dir==='down'?'var(--accent-red)':'var(--text-muted)'}">${dirIcon} ${row.delta}</td>
            <td>
                <div class="sparkline-cell">${sparkBars}</div>
            </td>
        `;
        tbody.appendChild(tr);
    });
}

/* ===========================================
   SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
   Handles: keyboard nav, scroll snap, touch,
   IntersectionObserver animations, progress bar, nav dots
   =========================================== */
class SlidePresentation {
    constructor() {
        this.slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
        this.total = this.slides.length;
        this.currentIdx = 0;
        this.isScrolling = false;

        buildTrendTable();
        this.setupIntersectionObserver();
        this.setupNavDots();
        this.setupKeyboard();
        this.setupWheel();
        this.setupTouch();
        this.updateProgress(0);
    }

    /* Intersection Observer — adds .visible to trigger CSS animations */
    setupIntersectionObserver() {
        const opts = { threshold: 0.4 };
        this.observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                    const idx = this.slides.indexOf(entry.target);
                    if (idx !== -1) {
                        this.currentIdx = idx;
                        this.updateProgress(idx);
                        this.updateNavDots(idx);
                    }
                }
            });
        }, opts);
        this.slides.forEach(s => this.observer.observe(s));
    }

    /* Progress bar — width reflects position in deck */
    updateProgress(idx) {
        const pct = this.total > 1 ? (idx / (this.total - 1)) * 100 : 100;
        document.getElementById('progressBar').style.width = pct + '%';
    }

    /* Nav dots — generated and kept in sync */
    setupNavDots() {
        const nav = document.getElementById('navDots');
        this.slides.forEach((s, i) => {
            const dot = document.createElement('button');
            dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
            dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
            dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goTo(i));
            nav.appendChild(dot);
        });
        this.dots = Array.from(nav.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot'));
    }

    updateNavDots(idx) {
        this.dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === idx));
    }

    /* Scroll to a given slide index */
    goTo(idx) {
        if (idx < 0 || idx >= this.total) return;
        this.slides[idx].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
    }

    /* Keyboard navigation — arrow keys, Space, Page */
    setupKeyboard() {
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            switch (e.key) {
                case 'ArrowDown': case 'ArrowRight': case ' ':
                    e.preventDefault(); this.goTo(this.currentIdx + 1); break;
                case 'ArrowUp': case 'ArrowLeft':
                    e.preventDefault(); this.goTo(this.currentIdx - 1); break;
                case 'PageDown':
                    e.preventDefault(); this.goTo(this.currentIdx + 1); break;
                case 'PageUp':
                    e.preventDefault(); this.goTo(this.currentIdx - 1); break;
                case 'Home':
                    e.preventDefault(); this.goTo(0); break;
                case 'End':
                    e.preventDefault(); this.goTo(this.total - 1); break;
            }
        });
    }

    /* Mouse wheel nav — one slide per wheel event */
    setupWheel() {
        let lastWheel = 0;
        document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            const now = Date.now();
            if (now - lastWheel < 700) return; // debounce
            lastWheel = now;
            if (e.deltaY > 0) this.goTo(this.currentIdx + 1);
            else this.goTo(this.currentIdx - 1);
        }, { passive: false });
    }

    /* Touch swipe support */
    setupTouch() {
        let startY = 0;
        document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { startY = e.touches[0].clientY; }, { passive: true });
        document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
            const delta = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
            if (Math.abs(delta) > 50) {
                if (delta > 0) this.goTo(this.currentIdx + 1);
                else this.goTo(this.currentIdx - 1);
            }
        }, { passive: true });
    }
}

/* Boot */
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    new SlidePresentation();
});
</script>

</body>
</html>

            flex-direction: column;
            position: relative;
        }

        .slide-content {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            max-height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
        }

        .card, .container, .content-box {
            max-width: min(90vw, 1000px);
            max-height: min(80vh, 700px);
        }

        .feature-list, .bullet-list { gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 1rem); }
        .feature-list li, .bullet-list li { font-size: var(--body-size); line-height: 1.4; }

        img, .image-container {
            max-width: 100%;
            max-height: min(50vh, 400px);
            object-fit: contain;
        }

        @media (max-height: 700px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.75rem, 3vw, 2rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 4.5vw, 2.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.75rem);
            }
        }

        @media (max-height: 600px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.5rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.3rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.1rem, 4vw, 2rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 0.95rem);
            }
            .nav-dots, .keyboard-hint, .decorative { display: none; }
        }

        @media (max-height: 500px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.4rem, 2vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1rem, 3.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(0.9rem, 2.5vw, 1.25rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            :root { --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 7vw, 2.5rem); }
        }

        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            *, *::before, *::after {
                animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                transition-duration: 0.2s !important;
            }
            html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           GLOBAL BACKGROUND GRID PATTERN
           =========================================== */
        .slide::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(var(--grid-line) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, var(--grid-line) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 60px 60px;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
        }

        .slide > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }

        /* ===========================================
           ANIMATIONS — Entrance Reveals
           =========================================== */
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(28px);
            transition: opacity 0.65s var(--ease-out-expo), transform 0.65s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .reveal-left {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(calc(-1 * clamp(20px, 3vw, 40px)));
            transition: opacity 0.6s var(--ease-out-expo), transform 0.6s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: scale(0.92);
            transition: opacity 0.5s var(--ease-out-quint), transform 0.5s var(--ease-out-quint);
        }

        .slide.visible .reveal,
        .slide.visible .reveal-left,
        .slide.visible .reveal-scale { opacity: 1; transform: none; }

        /* Staggered delays */
        .reveal:nth-child(1), .reveal-left:nth-child(1), .reveal-scale:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.05s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(2), .reveal-left:nth-child(2), .reveal-scale:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.15s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(3), .reveal-left:nth-child(3), .reveal-scale:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.25s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(4), .reveal-left:nth-child(4), .reveal-scale:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.35s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.42s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 0.49s; }

        /* For table rows and chart bars staggered by JS */
        .row-reveal { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(calc(-1 * clamp(12px, 2vw, 20px))); transition: opacity 0.5s var(--ease-out-expo), transform 0.5s var(--ease-out-expo); }
        .slide.visible .row-reveal { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
        .bar-reveal { opacity: 0; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: opacity 0.6s, transform 0.6s var(--ease-out-expo); }
        .slide.visible .bar-reveal { opacity: 1; transform: scaleX(1); }

        /* ===========================================
           PROGRESS BAR
           =========================================== */
        .progress-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0; left: 0;
            height: 2px;
            background: var(--accent);
            z-index: 9999;
            transition: width 0.3s var(--ease-out-quint);
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-glow);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           NAV DOTS
           =========================================== */
        .nav-dots {
            position: fixed;
            right: clamp(0.75rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            z-index: 9998;
        }

        .nav-dot {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--text-muted);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: background 0.25s, transform 0.25s;
        }

        .nav-dot.active {
            background: var(--accent);
            transform: scale(1.4);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SHARED SLIDE COMPONENTS
           =========================================== */

        /* Slide number badge */
        .slide-badge {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 0.12em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 1rem);
        }

        .slide-badge span {
            color: var(--accent);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        /* Section heading */
        .slide-heading {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.15;
            letter-spacing: -0.01em;
        }

        .slide-heading em {
            font-style: normal;
            color: var(--accent);
        }

        /* Accent line under heading */
        .heading-rule {
            width: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
            height: 2px;
            background: var(--accent);
            margin: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem) 0;
            border-radius: 1px;
        }

        /* Callout pill */
        .callout-pill {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.4em;
            padding: 0.25em 0.75em;
            border-radius: 999px;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 500;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        }

        .callout-pill.amber { background: var(--accent-dim); color: var(--accent); border: 1px solid rgba(245,166,35,0.3); }
        .callout-pill.green { background: rgba(57,217,138,0.12); color: var(--accent-green); border: 1px solid rgba(57,217,138,0.25); }
        .callout-pill.red { background: rgba(255,92,92,0.12); color: var(--accent-red); border: 1px solid rgba(255,92,92,0.25); }
        .callout-pill.blue { background: rgba(77,148,255,0.12); color: var(--accent-blue); border: 1px solid rgba(77,148,255,0.25); }

        /* Source label */
        .source-label {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1.2rem);
            left: var(--slide-padding);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 1 — TITLE SLIDE
           =========================================== */
        .title-slide {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .title-slide::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: -20%;
            right: -10%;
            width: min(60vw, 700px);
            height: min(60vw, 700px);
            background: radial-gradient(ellipse, rgba(245,166,35,0.06) 0%, transparent 70%);
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
        }

        .title-slide .inner {
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            max-width: min(90vw, 1100px);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1.2rem);
        }

        .title-eyebrow {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent);
            letter-spacing: 0.18em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .title-main {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 5.5vw, 4.8rem);
            line-height: 1.05;
            letter-spacing: -0.025em;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            max-width: min(85vw, 900px);
        }

        .title-main .accent-word { color: var(--accent); }

        .title-sub {
            font-size: clamp(0.8rem, 1.4vw, 1.1rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
            max-width: min(70vw, 650px);
        }

        .title-meta {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            align-items: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 1rem);
        }

        .title-meta-item {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.2em;
        }

        .title-meta-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        }

        .title-meta-value {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .title-divider {
            width: clamp(3rem, 6vw, 6rem);
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), transparent);
            margin: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vw, 0.6rem) 0;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 2 — LANGUAGE TRENDS (COMPARISON TABLE)
           =========================================== */
        .trends-slide .slide-content {
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            justify-content: flex-start;
            padding-top: clamp(1rem, 2vh, 2.5rem);
        }

        .trends-header {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vw, 0.5rem);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 1rem);
        }

        /* Trend table */
        .trend-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            table-layout: fixed;
        }

        .trend-table th {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            padding: clamp(0.3rem, 0.5vw, 0.5rem) clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem);
            text-align: right;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        }

        .trend-table th:first-child { text-align: left; }

        .trend-table td {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--mono-size);
            padding: clamp(0.2rem, 0.4vw, 0.45rem) clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem);
            text-align: right;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .trend-table td:first-child {
            text-align: left;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .trend-table tr:hover td { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); }

        /* Trend indicator arrows */
        .trend-arrow-up { color: var(--accent-green); font-size: 0.9em; }
        .trend-arrow-down { color: var(--accent-red); font-size: 0.9em; }
        .trend-arrow-flat { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.9em; }

        /* Value cells — color-coded by magnitude */
        .val-high { color: var(--text-primary) !important; font-weight: 500; }
        .val-peak { color: var(--accent) !important; font-weight: 500; }
        .val-low { color: var(--text-muted) !important; }
        .val-dash { color: var(--text-muted) !important; opacity: 0.4; }

        .trend-table .lang-badge {
            display: inline-block;
            width: 8px; height: 8px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            margin-right: 0.5em;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .lang-name-cell { display: flex; align-items: center; }

        /* Sparkline mini-bars inside table */
        .sparkline-cell {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: flex-end;
            gap: 2px;
        }

        .spark-bar {
            width: clamp(3px, 0.5vw, 5px);
            border-radius: 1px;
            background: var(--text-muted);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 3 — PRIMARY LANGUAGE
           =========================================== */
        .primary-slide .slide-content {
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            flex-direction: row;
            gap: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 4rem);
            align-items: flex-start;
            padding-top: clamp(1rem, 2vh, 2.5rem);
        }

        .primary-left { flex: 0 0 auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 1rem); }
        .primary-right { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 1rem); }

        /* Horizontal bar chart */
        .hbar-chart { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: clamp(0.35rem, 0.7vw, 0.65rem); width: 100%; }

        .hbar-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem); }

        .hbar-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--mono-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            width: clamp(6rem, 10vw, 9rem);
            text-align: right;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .hbar-track {
            flex: 1;
            height: clamp(14px, 2.2vh, 22px);
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
            border-radius: 3px;
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
        }

        .hbar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 3px;
            position: relative;
            transition: width 0s; /* Width set by JS after slide visible */
        }

        .hbar-val {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            width: clamp(2rem, 3.5vw, 3rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            text-align: left;
        }

        .hbar-val.primary-lang { color: var(--text-primary); font-weight: 500; }
        .hbar-fill.primary-lang { background: var(--accent); }
        .hbar-fill.secondary-lang { background: rgba(77,148,255,0.7); }
        .hbar-fill.intent-bar { background: rgba(57,217,138,0.6); }

        /* Split comparison */
        .comparison-section { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vw, 0.6rem); }
        .comparison-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            margin-bottom: 0.2em;
        }

        .insight-box {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent);
            border-radius: 4px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1vw, 1rem) clamp(0.75rem, 1.2vw, 1.2rem);
        }

        .insight-text {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .insight-text strong { color: var(--text-primary); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 4 — DEVELOPER SATISFACTION
           =========================================== */
        .satisfaction-slide .slide-content {
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            flex-direction: row;
            gap: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 4rem);
            align-items: flex-start;
            padding-top: clamp(1rem, 2vh, 2.5rem);
        }

        .satisfaction-left { flex: 0 0 auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 1rem); max-width: clamp(180px, 22vw, 280px); }
        .satisfaction-right { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.5vw, 0.5rem); }

        .sat-bar-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem);
        }

        .sat-rank {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            width: 1.4em;
            text-align: right;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .sat-lang-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--mono-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            width: clamp(5.5rem, 9vw, 8.5rem);
            text-align: right;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .sat-track {
            flex: 1;
            height: clamp(12px, 1.8vh, 18px);
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
            border-radius: 3px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .sat-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 3px;
        }

        .sat-score {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            width: clamp(2.2rem, 3.5vw, 3rem);
            text-align: left;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .sat-score.top-score { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 500; }
        .sat-score.high-score { color: var(--text-primary); }
        .sat-score.mid-score { color: var(--text-secondary); }

        .sat-fill.ts-fill { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), rgba(245,166,35,0.7)); }
        .sat-fill.rust-fill { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #e0783c, rgba(224,120,60,0.7)); }
        .sat-fill.py-fill { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-blue), rgba(77,148,255,0.7)); }
        .sat-fill.go-fill { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #00add8, rgba(0,173,216,0.7)); }
        .sat-fill.lua-fill { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-purple), rgba(167,139,250,0.7)); }
        .sat-fill.cpp-fill { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #659ad2, rgba(101,154,210,0.7)); }
        .sat-fill.kt-fill { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #a97bff, rgba(169,123,255,0.6)); }
        .sat-fill.sh-fill { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-green), rgba(57,217,138,0.7)); }
        .sat-fill.dart-fill { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #40c4ff, rgba(64,196,255,0.6)); }
        .sat-fill.c-fill { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #5c6bc0, rgba(92,107,192,0.6)); }

        /* Big insight stat */
        .big-stat {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 4.5rem);
            color: var(--accent);
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .big-stat-label {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            line-height: 1.4;
            margin-top: 0.25em;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 5 — DOMAIN SPECIALIZATION (HEATMAP TABLE)
           =========================================== */
        .domain-slide .slide-content {
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            justify-content: flex-start;
            padding-top: clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vh, 2rem);
        }

        .domain-table-wrap {
            width: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .domain-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            table-layout: fixed;
        }

        .domain-table th {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.07em;
            padding: clamp(0.3rem, 0.5vw, 0.5rem) clamp(0.4rem, 0.7vw, 0.7rem);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            text-align: left;
        }

        .domain-table td {
            padding: clamp(0.25rem, 0.45vw, 0.45rem) clamp(0.4rem, 0.7vw, 0.7rem);
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            vertical-align: middle;
        }

        .domain-table td.domain-name {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .domain-table td.lang-cell {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--mono-size);
        }

        /* Heat chip — colored cell */
        .heat-chip {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.35em;
            padding: 0.2em 0.65em;
            border-radius: 3px;
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .heat-primary { background: rgba(245,166,35,0.18); color: var(--accent); }
        .heat-strong { background: rgba(77,148,255,0.16); color: var(--accent-blue); }
        .heat-moderate { background: rgba(57,217,138,0.14); color: var(--accent-green); }
        .heat-special { background: rgba(167,139,250,0.16); color: var(--accent-purple); }
        .heat-neutral { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); color: var(--text-secondary); }

        .share-badge {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-left: 0.3em;
        }

        .secondary-langs {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 6 — STRATEGIC TAKEAWAYS
           =========================================== */
        .strategy-slide .slide-content {
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            justify-content: flex-start;
            padding-top: clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vh, 2rem);
        }

        .strategy-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 1rem);
            width: 100%;
        }

        .strategy-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.1vw, 1.1rem) clamp(0.75rem, 1.2vw, 1.2rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.5vw, 0.5rem);
            transition: border-color 0.2s;
        }

        .strategy-card-number {

    { lang: 'Kotlin',     color: '#a97bff', vals: ['2%', '17%','16%','14%'], delta: '+12 pp', dir: 'flat', note: 'Plateaued' },
];

function buildTrendTable() {
    const tbody = document.getElementById('trendTableBody');
    trendData.forEach((row, i) => {
        const tr = document.createElement('tr');
        tr.className = 'row-reveal';
        tr.style.transitionDelay = (0.05 + i * 0.04) + 's';

        // Sparkline bars: normalize vs max value seen (70 for JS)
        const rawNums = row.vals.map(v => parseFloat(v.replace('%','').replace('—','0')));
        const sparkBars = rawNums.map(n => {
            const h = Math.round(Math.max(2, n / 70 * 20));
            const alpha = n > 0 ? 0.3 + (n/70)*0.6 : 0.1;
            return `<div class="spark-bar" style="height:${h}px;background:${row.color};opacity:${alpha.toFixed(2)}"></div>`;
        }).join('');

        const dirIcon = row.dir === 'up' ? '<span class="trend-arrow-up">▲</span>'
                      : row.dir === 'down' ? '<span class="trend-arrow-down">▼</span>'
                      : '<span class="trend-arrow-flat">●</span>';

        // Determine peak value to highlight
        const maxVal = Math.max(...rawNums);

        const cells = row.vals.map((v, vi) => {
            const num = parseFloat(v.replace('%','').replace('—','0'));
            let cls = '';
            if (v === '—') cls = 'val-dash';
            else if (num === maxVal && maxVal > 0) cls = 'val-peak';
            else if (num >= 45) cls = 'val-high';
            else if (num < 20 && num > 0) cls = 'val-low';
            return `<td class="${cls}">${v}</td>`;
        }).join('');

        tr.innerHTML = `
            <td>
                <div class="lang-name-cell">
                    <span class="lang-badge" style="background:${row.color}"></span>
                    ${row.lang}
                </div>
            </td>
            ${cells}
            <td style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:var(--label-size);color:${row.dir==='up'?'var(--accent-green)':row.dir==='down'?'var(--accent-red)':'var(--text-muted)'}">${dirIcon} ${row.delta}</td>
            <td>
                <div class="sparkline-cell">${sparkBars}</div>
            </td>
        `;
        tbody.appendChild(tr);
    });
}

/* ===========================================
   SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
   Handles: keyboard nav, scroll snap, touch,
   IntersectionObserver animations, progress bar, nav dots
   =========================================== */
class SlidePresentation {
    constructor() {
        this.slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
        this.total = this.slides.length;
        this.currentIdx = 0;
        this.isScrolling = false;

        buildTrendTable();
        this.setupIntersectionObserver();
        this.setupNavDots();
        this.setupKeyboard();
        this.setupWheel();
        this.setupTouch();
        this.updateProgress(0);
    }

    /* Intersection Observer — adds .visible to trigger CSS animations */
    setupIntersectionObserver() {
        const opts = { threshold: 0.4 };
        this.observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                    const idx = this.slides.indexOf(entry.target);
                    if (idx !== -1) {
                        this.currentIdx = idx;
                        this.updateProgress(idx);
                        this.updateNavDots(idx);
                    }
                }
            });
        }, opts);
        this.slides.forEach(s => this.observer.observe(s));
    }

    /* Progress bar — width reflects position in deck */
    updateProgress(idx) {
        const pct = this.total > 1 ? (idx / (this.total - 1)) * 100 : 100;
        document.getElementById('progressBar').style.width = pct + '%';
    }

    /* Nav dots — generated and kept in sync */
    setupNavDots() {
        const nav = document.getElementById('navDots');
        this.slides.forEach((s, i) => {
            const dot = document.createElement('button');
            dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
            dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
            dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goTo(i));
            nav.appendChild(dot);
        });
        this.dots = Array.from(nav.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot'));
    }

    updateNavDots(idx) {
        this.dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === idx));
    }

    /* Scroll to a given slide index */
    goTo(idx) {
        if (idx < 0 || idx >= this.total) return;
        this.slides[idx].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
    }

    /* Keyboard navigation — arrow keys, Space, Page */
    setupKeyboard() {
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            switch (e.key) {
                case 'ArrowDown': case 'ArrowRight': case ' ':
                    e.preventDefault(); this.goTo(this.currentIdx + 1); break;
                case 'ArrowUp': case 'ArrowLeft':
                    e.preventDefault(); this.goTo(this.currentIdx - 1); break;
                case 'PageDown':
                    e.preventDefault(); this.goTo(this.currentIdx + 1); break;
                case 'PageUp':
                    e.preventDefault(); this.goTo(this.currentIdx - 1); break;
                case 'Home':
                    e.preventDefault(); this.goTo(0); break;
                case 'End':
                    e.preventDefault(); this.goTo(this.total - 1); break;
            }
        });
    }

    /* Mouse wheel nav — one slide per wheel event */
    setupWheel() {
        let lastWheel = 0;
        document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            const now = Date.now();
            if (now - lastWheel < 700) return; // debounce
            lastWheel = now;
            if (e.deltaY > 0) this.goTo(this.currentIdx + 1);
            else this.goTo(this.currentIdx - 1);
        }, { passive: false });
    }

    /* Touch swipe support */
    setupTouch() {
        let startY = 0;
        document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { startY = e.touches[0].clientY; }, { passive: true });
        document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
            const delta = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
            if (Math.abs(delta) > 50) {
                if (delta > 0) this.goTo(this.currentIdx + 1);
                else this.goTo(this.currentIdx - 1);
            }
        }, { passive: true });
    }
}

/* Boot */
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    new SlidePresentation();
});
</script>

</body>
</html>

<script>
/* ===========================================
   TREND TABLE DATA — injected for staggered animation
   Values from source_brief.md (no fabricated data)
   =========================================== */
const trendData = [
    { lang: 'JavaScript', color: '#f7df1e', vals: ['65%','70%','65%','61%'], delta: '-4 pp', dir: 'down', note: 'Peak 2020, declining' },

    { lang: 'TypeScript', color: '#2b7489', vals: ['12%','28%','34%','37%'], delta: '+25 pp', dir: 'up',   note: 'Strong growth (3×)' },
    { lang: 'Go',         color: '#00add8', vals: ['8%', '19%','19%','18%'], delta: '+10 pp', dir: 'flat', note: 'Plateaued after growth' },
    { lang: 'Rust',       color: '#dea584', vals: ['—',  '7%', '9%', '11%'], delta: 'n/a→11%', dir: 'up',  note: 'Steady growth' },
    { lang: 'PHP',        color: '#4f5d95', vals: ['30%','27%','20%','17%'], delta: '-13 pp', dir: 'down', note: 'Significant decline' },
    { lang: 'Kotlin',     color: '#a97bff', vals: ['2%', '17%','16%','14%'], delta: '+12 pp', dir: 'flat', note: 'Plateaued' },
];

function buildTrendTable() {
    const tbody = document.getElementById('trendTableBody');
    trendData.forEach((row, i) => {
        const tr = document.createElement('tr');
        tr.className = 'row-reveal';
        tr.style.transitionDelay = (0.05 + i * 0.04) + 's';

        // Sparkline bars: normalize vs max value seen (70 for JS)
        const rawNums = row.vals.map(v => parseFloat(v.replace('%','').replace('—','0')));
        const sparkBars = rawNums.map(n => {
            const h = Math.round(Math.max(2, n / 70 * 20));
            const alpha = n > 0 ? 0.3 + (n/70)*0.6 : 0.1;
            return `<div class="spark-bar" style="height:${h}px;background:${row.color};opacity:${alpha.toFixed(2)}"></div>`;
        }).join('');

        const dirIcon = row.dir === 'up' ? '<span class="trend-arrow-up">▲</span>'
                      : row.dir === 'down' ? '<span class="trend-arrow-down">▼</span>'
                      : '<span class="trend-arrow-flat">●</span>';

        // Determine peak value to highlight
        const maxVal = Math.max(...rawNums);

        const cells = row.vals.map((v, vi) => {
            const num = parseFloat(v.replace('%','').replace('—','0'));
            let cls = '';
            if (v === '—') cls = 'val-dash';
            else if (num === maxVal && maxVal > 0) cls = 'val-peak';
            else if (num >= 45) cls = 'val-high';
            else if (num < 20 && num > 0) cls = 'val-low';
            return `<td class="${cls}">${v}</td>`;
        }).join('');

        tr.innerHTML = `
            <td>
                <div class="lang-name-cell">
                    <span class="lang-badge" style="background:${row.color}"></span>
                    ${row.lang}
                </div>
            </td>
            ${cells}
            <td style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:var(--label-size);color:${row.dir==='up'?'var(--accent-green)':row.dir==='down'?'var(--accent-red)':'var(--text-muted)'}">${dirIcon} ${row.delta}</td>
            <td>
                <div class="sparkline-cell">${sparkBars}</div>
            </td>
        `;
        tbody.appendChild(tr);
    });
}

/* ===========================================
   SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
   Handles: keyboard nav, scroll snap, touch,
   IntersectionObserver animations, progress bar, nav dots
   =========================================== */
class SlidePresentation {
    constructor() {
        this.slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
        this.total = this.slides.length;
        this.currentIdx = 0;
        this.isScrolling = false;

        buildTrendTable();
        this.setupIntersectionObserver();
        this.setupNavDots();
        this.setupKeyboard();
        this.setupWheel();
        this.setupTouch();
        this.updateProgress(0);
    }

    /* Intersection Observer — adds .visible to trigger CSS animations */
    setupIntersectionObserver() {
        const opts = { threshold: 0.4 };
        this.observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                    const idx = this.slides.indexOf(entry.target);
                    if (idx !== -1) {
                        this.currentIdx = idx;
                        this.updateProgress(idx);
                        this.updateNavDots(idx);
                    }
                }
            });
        }, opts);
        this.slides.forEach(s => this.observer.observe(s));
    }

    /* Progress bar — width reflects position in deck */
    updateProgress(idx) {
        const pct = this.total > 1 ? (idx / (this.total - 1)) * 100 : 100;
        document.getElementById('progressBar').style.width = pct + '%';
    }

    /* Nav dots — generated and kept in sync */
    setupNavDots() {
        const nav = document.getElementById('navDots');
        this.slides.forEach((s, i) => {
            const dot = document.createElement('button');
            dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
            dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
            dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goTo(i));
            nav.appendChild(dot);
        });
        this.dots = Array.from(nav.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot'));
    }

    updateNavDots(idx) {
        this.dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === idx));
    }

    /* Scroll to a given slide index */
    goTo(idx) {
        if (idx < 0 || idx >= this.total) return;
        this.slides[idx].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
    }

    /* Keyboard navigation — arrow keys, Space, Page */
    setupKeyboard() {
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            switch (e.key) {
                case 'ArrowDown': case 'ArrowRight': case ' ':
                    e.preventDefault(); this.goTo(this.currentIdx + 1); break;
                case 'ArrowUp': case 'ArrowLeft':
                    e.preventDefault(); this.goTo(this.currentIdx - 1); break;
                case 'PageDown':
                    e.preventDefault(); this.goTo(this.currentIdx + 1); break;
                case 'PageUp':
                    e.preventDefault(); this.goTo(this.currentIdx - 1); break;
                case 'Home':
                    e.preventDefault(); this.goTo(0); break;
                case 'End':
                    e.preventDefault(); this.goTo(this.total - 1); break;
            }
        });
    }

    /* Mouse wheel nav — one slide per wheel event */
    setupWheel() {
        let lastWheel = 0;
        document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            const now = Date.now();
            if (now - lastWheel < 700) return; // debounce
            lastWheel = now;
            if (e.deltaY > 0) this.goTo(this.currentIdx + 1);
            else this.goTo(this.currentIdx - 1);
        }, { passive: false });
    }

    /* Touch swipe support */
    setupTouch() {
        let startY = 0;
        document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { startY = e.touches[0].clientY; }, { passive: true });
        document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
            const delta = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
            if (Math.abs(delta) > 50) {
                if (delta > 0) this.goTo(this.currentIdx + 1);
                else this.goTo(this.currentIdx - 1);
            }
        }, { passive: true });
    }
}

/* Boot */
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    new SlidePresentation();
});
</script>

91	    beyond the end.  We detect this by comparing file sizes + pixel samples.
92	    """
93	    pngs = sorted(image_dir.glob("slide_*.png"))
94	    if len(pngs) <= 1:
95	        return pngs
96	
97	    unique: list[Path] = [pngs[0]]
98	    prev_img = Image.open(pngs[0])
99	
100	    for png in pngs[1:]:
101	        curr_img = Image.open(png)
102	        # Quick check: compare a grid of sample pixels
103	        is_dup = True
104	        for x_frac in (0.25, 0.5, 0.75):
105	            for y_frac in (0.25, 0.5, 0.75):
106	                px = int(curr_img.width * x_frac)
107	                py = int(curr_img.height * y_frac)
108	                if curr_img.getpixel((px, py)) != prev_img.getpixel((px, py)):
109	                    is_dup = False
110	                    break
111	            if not is_dup:
112	                break
113	
114	        if not is_dup:
115	            unique.append(png)
116	            prev_img = curr_img
117	        else:
118	            # Once we hit a duplicate, stop — remaining are likely all dupes
119	            break
120	
121	    return unique

124	def _start_http_server(directory: Path, port: int = 0):
125	    """Start a background HTTP server serving *directory*. Returns (server, port)."""
126	    handler = http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler
127	    server = http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", port), lambda *a, **kw: handler(*a, directory=str(directory), **kw))
128	    actual_port = server.server_address[1]
129	    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
130	    thread.start()
131	    return server, actual_port

135	    """Run Playwright to capture per-slide PNGs. Returns deduplicated list."""
136	    # Serve via HTTP so Google Fonts and relative assets load correctly
137	    serve_dir = html_path.resolve().parent
138	    server, port = _start_http_server(serve_dir)
139	    url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/{html_path.resolve().name}"
140	
141	    try:

143	        script_file = out_dir / "_capture.cjs"
144	        script_file.write_text(script)
145	
146	        env = os.environ.copy()
147	        env.setdefault("NODE_PATH", "/usr/local/lib/node_modules:/app/node_modules")
148	        env.setdefault("PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH", "/ms-playwright")
149	        env.setdefault("PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD", "1")
150	        result = subprocess.run(
151	            ["node", str(script_file)],
152	            capture_output=True,
153	            text=True,
154	            timeout=180,
155	            env=env,
156	        )
157	        if result.returncode != 0:
158	            print(f"Playwright stderr:\n{result.stderr}", file=sys.stderr)
159	            raise RuntimeError(f"Screenshot script failed (exit {result.returncode})")
160	    finally:
161	        server.shutdown()
162	
163	    pngs = _deduplicate_slides(out_dir)
164	    if not pngs:
165	        raise RuntimeError("No slide screenshots produced")
166	    return pngs

170	    """Pack slide images into a standard 16:9 PPTX."""
171	    prs = Presentation()

173	    prs.slide_width = Emu(12192000)   # 13.333 inches
174	    prs.slide_height = Emu(6858000)   # 7.5 inches

182	            left=Emu(0),
183	            top=Emu(0),
184	            width=prs.slide_width,

The script uses `ArrowRight` to navigate, and my presentation uses smooth scroll snap. The issue is the deduplication logic is seeing all slides as duplicates because the scroll animation may not be completing. The script waits 600ms but my background grid is identical across slides, causing pixel-sample matches. I need to use `scrollIntoView` via `goTo` JS, or use the scroll position approach. Let me fix the presentation to also expose a `goToSlide` function and update the navigation to use direct scroll positioning.

The real problem: the deduplication routine samples 9 pixels and if the background pattern is similar, it flags slides as duplicates. The fix is to use direct per-slide scroll offsets in the capture script. Let me write a patched capture approach by modifying the HTML to respond to a URL hash, or better — I'll use a query-param based approach to render one slide at a time.

The simplest fix: write a standalone capture script that scrolls to each slide by `scrollTop` position directly.
